description: Price for a flat at an exact Yerevan address (e.g. 'Komitas 42', 'Комитаса 42', 'Կոմիտաս 42'): finds the building, estimates sale price (per m² and total) and monthly rent with a model trained on all listings (location down to the street segment, floor, renovation, building, metro, parks, schools, kindergartens), shows which factors push the price up or down, the building's floors/material, the street's median price, and distances to metro, schools, kindergartens, parks, playgrounds, shops, pharmacies, hospitals. Free. Цена по точному адресу и что рядом.

floors.description: floors in the building, if known (else taken from the building data)

name: estimate_address
title: Price at an exact address + what's nearby
